title: Connected Character Research Handoff
discord_message:
NEXUS | AZEROTH COMPANION v7.9.5 — Connected Character Research

New: move between Character Intelligence, Mythic+, Raid and Reputation research using one public character selector. You can copy shareable research links, and each studio waits for you to press Load before contacting Blizzard.

Also updated: PC/mobile handbook, Getting Started, community testing checklist, release history and Gateway information.

Real-character Blizzard testing is still pending. This release is a preview, not yet certified for an official stable announcement.
